commentary.text: 90+10' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+8' Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick.
90+6' The ball goes out for a corner. Mallorca can continue in their attacking effort.
90+4' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca) is given a yellow card.
90+2' Ricardo De Burgos shows the yellow card to Martin Valjent (Mallorca) for a heavy challenge.
90' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Corner kick. Espanyol will have an opportunity.
88' 2 - 1 Goal! Omar Mascarell tees up Samu Costa (Mallorca) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 2:1.
85' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) sees a yellow card from Ricardo De Burgos after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
83' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Johan Mojica walks off the pitch to be replaced by Zito Luvumbo (Mallorca).
83' The referee allows time for a substitution. Pablo Maffeo will be replaced by Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).
81' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jose Salinas (Espanyol) replacing Ramon Terrats.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jofre (Espanyol) replaces Tyrhys Dolan.
80' The foul by Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Ricardo De Burgos.
80' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) climbs highest inside the box and sends a poor header miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
79' The attendance for today's match is 17879.
75' Martin Demichelis has decided to make a change. Sergi Darder (Mallorca) replaces Pablo Torre.
75' Lovely cross from Pablo Maffeo to find Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) deep in the box, but he steers his header well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
71' It's time for a substitution. Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) comes on in place of Kike Garcia.
71' Manolo Gonzalez decides to make a substitution. Clemens Riedel will be replaced by Pol Lozano (Espanyol).
70' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Mallorca players have a reason to celebrate!
67' The Mallorca players halt their celebrations as referee Ricardo De Burgos makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
65' 1 - 1 Pablo Torre (Mallorca) picks up the ball on the edge of the penalty box and produces a moment of magic with a brilliant shot that goes into the left side of the goal!
65' Marko Dmitrovic leaps like a salmon to deny Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca), whose effort is headed to the underside of the crossbar, but isn't powerful enough to find its way into the back of the net.
64' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. It's a throw-in for Mallorca.
63' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears.
61' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Pablo Torre (Mallorca), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
57' Martin Demichelis prepares a substitution. Manu Morlanes is replaced by Justin-Noel Kalumba (Mallorca).
57' Here's the change. Exposito leaves the pitch and Miguel Rubio (Espanyol) comes on as a substitute.
54' It‘s a RED card, and quite right too after seeing the replay! Referee Ricardo De Burgos had no choice but to send Charles Pickel (Espanyol) off. VAR seen to good effect there!

53' There's a break in play and the referee must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier infringement by Charles Pickel (Espanyol) using VAR. This could result in a red card!
50' Decent spell from Espanyol here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in. The linesman signals a throw-in for Espanyol.
48' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

47' It looked like the long-range shot by Pablo Torre (Mallorca) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the left post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time. The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
46' Espanyol seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The whistle blows and Ricardo De Burgos starts the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
43' Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marko Dmitrovic, who smothers the ball.
42' The Mallorca players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
40' Ricardo De Burgos shows a yellow card to Johan Mojica (Mallorca) for his blatant foul.
38' Mallorca enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

36' 0 - 1 Goal! A terrific long pass from Tyrhys Dolan picks out an unmarked Charles Pickel (Espanyol) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
33' Exposito (Espanyol) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
33' Corner kick. Clemens Riedel (Espanyol) is ready to send the ball into the box.
31' Ricardo De Burgos shows a yellow card to Clemens Riedel (Espanyol), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
30' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Kike Garcia (Espanyol) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
29' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Mallorca.
27' Mallorca have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

26' Leo Roman makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom left corner.
26' The linesman points to the corner flag, Mallorca are going to take it.

25' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) gathers a nice lofted pass deep inside the box and attempts to put the ball into roof of the net, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players. It will be a corner kick for Mallorca.
22' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marko Dmitrovic intercepts the ball.
22' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 60:40.
22' The Mallorca players are exchanging some short passes.
20' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) fires the ball towards the right side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
18' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
17' Exposito (Espanyol) produces a cross from the resulting free kick far from the goal, but there's no one to really attack the ball and the goalkeeper gathers easily.
16' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) and Omar Mascarell perform a quick tiki-taka to get past two defenders and then continue the move along the side line.
15' The Mallorca players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
13' One of the players from Espanyol times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
12' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Mallorca was in an offside position.
11' The Mallorca players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
10' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.

8' Espanyol are showing great team-chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly but finally one of the defending players makes an interception. The ball is behind the touchline and Espanyol will take a throw-in.
7' Exposito (Espanyol) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
7' Exposito (Espanyol) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
6' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. Espanyol earn a corner.
5' Mallorca keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
4' Espanyol are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
3' Mallorca control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
2' Exposito (Espanyol) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
2' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Espanyol have a corner.
1' Mallorca are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession.
1' The match has just started.
Mallorca will kick the game off.
